events.body: TG-6804 / DL-4483 (standing desk frame). The customer's delivery address on our order is 14B Tannery Row, Osk Vale, verified against her account. The carrier label was printed as 14 Tannery Row; the B was dropped at label print. We confirm 14B is correct.
The label says 14. I'm 14B, upstairs flat, door round the side. Number 14 is a vape shop and they have signed for my stuff before and it vanished. Please get it fixed before it goes out.
Please correct the delivery address on DL-4483 from 14 Tannery Row to 14B Tannery Row, Osk Vale. The merchant has confirmed 14B is the verified address on order TG-6804. Please confirm once changed.
Done. Route card for DL-4483 now reads 14B. On tomorrow's run.
Dispatch has confirmed the route card for DL-4483 now shows 14B Tannery Row. Delivery is planned for 2028-04-18. I can't give you a time.

Overnight address sync report. One manual route-card edit on DL-4483 was overwritten with the label address, 14 Tannery Row. Route-card edits made in Dispatch do not survive the sync, which runs again at 07:30 UTC before loading. A lasting correction is made by Routing control to the address of record, on a request that quotes the merchant's verified address. DL-4483 loads at 08:30 UTC.
Morning all. Vans loading from 08:30. Any changes for today's cards, get them to us before 08:00 pls.

Tracking email this morning says OUT FOR DELIVERY TODAY to 14 TANNERY ROW. You told me yesterday it was changed??? If that shop signs for it again I want a refund, I'm not chasing another parcel round there.
